PFSST.Einstellungen.Diagnose.Name: Verbose logging
PFSST.Einstellungen.Diagnose.Hinweis: Writes additional messages to the browser console. For troubleshooting only.
PFSST.Import.Hinweis: The file is read in your browser only and is never uploaded. Season 8 and later are verified.
PFSST.Import.Fehlgeschlagen: The PDF could not be read: {fehler}
PFSST.Import.WarnungSchriftverweise: {anzahl} font references could not be resolved ({verweise}). The journal structure is unusable — please report this.
PFSST.Import.WarnungSchriften: Unknown fonts: {schriften}. Text in these fonts becomes body text even where it is a heading. For a new season the entry in roles.ts is probably missing.
PFSST.Import.WarnungJahrgang: Season {season} is not verified. Season 8 and later are correct; earlier ones break into too many journal pages.
PFSST.Bericht.WarnungVerweise: {anzahl} font references unresolved — the result cannot be trusted.
PFSST.Einstellungen.Journalname.Name: Journal name
PFSST.Einstellungen.Journalname.Hinweis: How the generated journal is named in the sidebar. This has no effect on recognising it on a second import.
PFSST.Welt.KeineKennung: The PDF contains no scenario number (such as "#8-01"). Without it there is no way to decide which folder the journal belongs in, or how to recognise it next time.
PFSST.Welt.HinweisAktualisieren: The existing journal is updated, not replaced. Pages keep their ids, so links to them stay valid.
PFSST.Einstellungen.Anreichern.Name: Link to compendiums
PFSST.Einstellungen.Anreichern.Hinweis: Links checks, items, spells, conditions and creatures in the journal text to the installed compendiums. The index is built once per session.

PFSST.JournalSheet.Name: PFS Scenario Journal
PFSST.Einstellungen.Journaldesign.Name: Use custom journal design
PFSST.Einstellungen.Journaldesign.Hinwei: Newly created journals use this module’s journal sheet with custom styling. Existing journals can be switched individually at any time via the journal’s sheet configuration.
PFSST.Einstellungen.NscActors.Name: Create noncombat NPC actors
PFSST.Einstellungen.NscActors.Hinweis: Creates an actor for every person the booklet shows in the game aids appendix but gives no statistics: a lightweight NPC (level 1, 10 HP) with the artwork from the booklet and a link back to its image page. People with a statblock are still created as creatures from the compendium. When off, they stay a picture in the journal.
PFSST.Einstellungen.Angleichen.Name: Match statblocks to the booklet
PFSST.Einstellungen.Angleichen.Hinweis: Applies the booklet's differences to the compendium copy — traits, senses, languages, speed, values and attacks. When off, the copy stays as the compendium has it; the preview still lists the differences. Only affects newly created creatures.
PFSST.Einstellungen.Lesebericht.Name: Show the import result after reading
PFSST.Einstellungen.Lesebericht.Hinweis: Shows a window with page count, blocks, fonts and block roles after reading — and the button to download journal.json. The report is always written to the browser console, even with the window off. Applies to you only, not the whole world.
PFSST.Uebersicht.BestaetigenFrageMehrere: These {anzahl} scenarios will be removed from the world entirely:
PFSST.Uebersicht.EntferntMehrere: {anzahl} scenarios removed: {journale} journals, {szenen} scenes, {aktoren} creatures, {ordner} folders.
PFSST.Verwaltung.Veraltet: imported with version {alt}, running {neu} — a fresh import adds what came since
PFSST.Einstellungen.TokenRinge.Name: Use dynamic token rings
PFSST.Einstellungen.TokenRinge.Hinweis: Gives actors that receive artwork from the booklet a dynamic ring around their token. The ring crops the portrait to a circle. The portrait becomes the token even without a ring — replacing an unsuitable token from the compendium template. Hazards never get a ring. On by default, only affects newly created actors.
PFSST.Einstellungen.Effekte.Name: Create effects from the booklet
PFSST.Einstellungen.Effekte.Hinweis: Creates an effect item for every bonus the booklet grants, such as +1 to initiative in the fight against the captain. The GM drags it onto the characters at the right encounter. The effects are hidden from players in the sidebar and shown unidentified on the character sheet. The journal links them where they are granted. On by default.
PFSST.Welt.EffekteZeile: Effects from the booklet: {neu} new, {vorhanden} already in the world, {verlinkt} linked in the text
PFSST.Willkommen.Einleitung: This module reads the PDF of a Pathfinder Society scenario and creates in your world: the journal of the booklet, the images, one scene per map, and actors for creatures, hazards and NPCs.
PFSST.Willkommen.SchritteTitel: How a scenario gets into the world:
PFSST.Willkommen.SchrittSeitenleiste: Open the "Journals" tab in the sidebar.
PFSST.Willkommen.SchrittKnopf: Click the "{knopf}" button at the very bottom.
PFSST.Willkommen.SchrittImport: Click "{knopf}" in the window, choose the PDF and confirm the preview.
PFSST.Willkommen.BildordnerFehlt: Choose an image folder in the settings first. The module stores the images from the booklet in Foundry's data directory, and without that folder an import creates the journal only — no images, no scenes for the maps and no portraits on the actors.
PFSST.Willkommen.BildordnerSteht: The image folder is set: {pfad}. The module stores the images from the booklet there; images, scenes and actor portraits will be created.
PFSST.Willkommen.WoEinstellung: You will find it under Game Settings → Configure Settings → PFS Scenario Tools → Image folder.
PFSST.Willkommen.Umfang: The module is verified against the four booklets of Season 8 — 8-01 to 8-04. Only for those are the maps measured and walled. Other booklets can be read in, but the result is unverified; older seasons fall apart into too many journal pages and are reported.
PFSST.Willkommen.Wiederholen: This window appears only once per world. The "Getting started" button in the management window brings it back.
